description: Run a saved test or a whole suite on a timer: once, daily, weekly on chosen days, or monthly on a day. Give `tests` instead of `test` to schedule several tests at once, one schedule each with the same timing. It runs the test or suite as it stands when it fires, so later edits are picked up. Every scheduled run uses conversation credits, so schedule what the user asked for.

day_of_month.description: For monthly: the day of the month.
day_of_month.title: Day Of Month

days.description: For weekly: the days, 0 for Monday to 6 for Sunday.
days.title: Days

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

schedule_type.description: once (at the next such time), daily, weekly (on days) or monthly (on day_of_month).
schedule_type.title: Schedule Type

suite.description: Or the suite to run (id or name); 'core' is the Core suite.
suite.title: Suite

test.description: The saved test to run, as list_tests shows it.
test.title: Test

tests.description: Or several saved tests: one schedule each, all with the same timing, as Test Lab makes them for a selection.
tests.title: Tests

timezone.description: An IANA time zone, such as Europe/Berlin.
timezone.title: Timezone

name: create_schedule
